2610.13623.title: APEX-Harm: Evaluating Agent Safety in Shared Professional Workspaces
2610.13623.paper_summary: Professional agents increasingly work through command-line interfaces and multiple tools over shared workspaces containing files, messages, and business applications. These environments create safety risks that are difficult to capture with attacks placed at a single, known read location. We introduce APEX-Harm, a benchmark for evaluating prompt and script injection against long-horizon agents performing finance, consulting, and legal tasks in large workspaces. Each task contains 115 to 328 files, together with email, calendar, chat, document, spreadsheet, PDF, and code-execution tools exposed through MCP servers. The benchmark includes six attack categories covering static and dynamic injections, task-specific script replacement, and attacker-provided generic scripts, and evaluates attack success, exposure, and task performance. We evaluate 12 frontier models on 180 task instances per model. Opus 5 and Sonnet 5 have the lowest overall attack success rates (8% and 20%), while task-specific script replacement and attacker-provided generic script attacks remain substantially more effective, averaging 81-84% and 73% attack success, respectively. Gemini 3.8 Flash achieves the highest mean task score (0.877) while still exhibiting a 33% attack success rate. These results show that completing the requested task is not sufficient evidence of safe behavior: an agent can produce a correct deliverable while also performing an unauthorized action in the workspace.
2610.13623.paper_summary_zh: 專業代理人越來越多地通過命令行介面和多個工具在包含文件、消息和商業應用程序的共享工作空間中工作。這些環境創造了安全風險，這些風險很難通過在單一已知讀取位置進行的攻擊來捕捉。我們介紹了APEX-Harm，這是一個用於評估針對在大型工作空間中執行金融、諮詢和法律任務的長期代理的提示和腳本注入的基準。每個任務包含115到328個文件，以及通過MCP伺服器暴露的電子郵件、日曆、聊天、文檔、電子表格、PDF和代碼執行工具。該基準包括六個攻擊類別，涵蓋靜態和動態注入、特定任務的腳本替換，以及攻擊者提供的通用腳本，並評估攻擊成功率、暴露情況和任務表現。我們對每個模型的180個任務實例評估了12個前沿模型。Opus 5和Sonnet 5的整體攻擊成功率最低（8%和20%），而特定任務的腳本替換和攻擊者提供的通用腳本攻擊仍然顯著更有效，平均攻擊成功率分別為81-84%和73%。Gemini 3.8 Flash達到了最高的平均任務得分（0.877），同時仍顯示出33%的攻擊成功率。這些結果表明，完成請求的任務並不足以證明安全行為：一個代理可以生成正確的交付物，同時在工作空間中執行未經授權的行為。
